summary: Implement and verify unified MDAR Web & MDAR Excel (21 Sheets, Smart Import, Column Mapping Wizard, DoneProof)
details: Successfully implemented full unified development for MDAR: standardized English nomenclature to MDAR across all files; built Smart Import Engine supporting XLSX, XLS, CSV, TSV, TXT with automatic encoding, delimiter, and header discovery; built offline Smart Column Detection with bilingual synonym dictionary and heuristic confidence scoring; built Column Mapping Wizard modal with swap X/Y, auto-detect, and localStorage profiles; enhanced Batch Grid with two-way map point synchronization; rebuilt MDAR Excel companion to 21 organized sheets with authentic OpenXML formulas, fixed cell references, true UTM & Egypt ETM calculations; verified all gates T0-T4 with 100% pass across all test suites and built production bundles.
